Title: Mr. Noir, Rico Loco, Dawn Operation

Messages.Author: librarian
Messages.Body:
Seems like there is a deck here:

Mr. Noir [LoB:U]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Salubri
Group: 4
Capacity: 3
Discipline: for obe
Independent:
If Mr. Noir is burned in combat, you gain 2 pool. Scarce.
Artist: Peter Bergting

Rico Loco [Third:V]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Ventrue antitribu
Group: 4
Capacity: 2
Discipline: FOR
Sabbat. Black Hand:
If Rico is ready during your master phase, move a Bomb from your hand
or ash heap to him (no cost) or he takes 1 damage. During your untap
phase, if Rico is ready and has a Bomb, burn the Bomb and another
ready minion you control takes 2 damage.

Dawn Operation [Jyhad:U, VTES:U, CE:U, Anarchs:PG2, LoB:PA2]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Fortitude
[for] If this action is blocked, all damage inflicted to all vampires
in the resulting combat is aggravated. Any vampire attempting to block
may now choose not to block.
[FOR] As above, but vampires attempting to block cannot back out.
Artist: Christopher Rush; Brian LeBlanc

Just need a way to turbo Mr. Noir and the Bomb. Soul Gem? Some sort
of Necro trick? Other?

Frontal Assault should be used often, Embrace like crazy (gets the 2
blood off Mr. Noir), and then swarm oust.

best -

chris

Best to file this under: Bad Ideas or Sarcasm Misunderstood. ;)

1. Embracing salubri dudes, then planning to bring out new salubri -

Going to torpor without combat, fails to fulfill both conditions on

Messages.Author: d
Messages.Body:
Librarian, here is the deck you want:

Get 2 Blood Dolls onto Rico and the Castle into play, so you can trade
bombs for blood every round when you try to burn Mr. Noir.
He bleeds with the Marionette, if your prey takes it and taps a
minion, keep bleeding. If he blocks, then explode, and try to come
back the same turn through
crypt draw preparation or Hand of Conrad.
Should go up to 90 cards, but I leave the last 10 for anyone
interested to add their own flavour. (Deflection module? Allies? Some
gio-necro twist? More combat or rush?>)
Your !tremere get the dom outferior of Spirit Marionette, until you
upgrade them with Infernal Pact and put your castle to other
diabolical uses.

3x Rico Loco(G4)
